risk_note: RV2 settlement (settlement-plan B2-04x; BR-CALC-02, BR-FUND-04 ⑪, BR-FUND-18; S3). Read-only implementation of the PendingEarningsSource port shape (the ledger declaration lands with B2-04w; aligned after it merges): per user the estimated / pending / paused shares, expected credit period and credit_overdue; per app the waiting / estimated totals. Shares come from the effective union commission (settlement first, even zero), minus the snapshot reserve and the tlj deduction clamped at zero, each role rounded down separately with @couli/money; forfeited beneficiaries (in the snapshot or by a later event) get zero. Credit months and overdue use packages/domain. No writes. Only apps/api/src/modules/settlement/reads/** changed.
